native_hub.title: Connect a Tuya IR hub
native_hub.description: Connect the physical hub directly over your local network. Enter the gateway IP address, gateway Device ID and Local Key. If the IR module is a child device, also enter its Node ID. IR Studio validates the LAN connection and creates its own remote entity; no external Tuya integration is required.

abort.already_configured: This Tuya IR hub is already configured.

error.invalid_credentials: Enter the hub address, gateway Device ID and Local Key.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Tuya IR hub. Check its address, Device ID, Local Key, child Node ID and protocol version.

create_remote.title: Add a virtual IR remote
create_remote.description: A remote device and entity will be created in Home Assistant. The selected IR transmitter will learn and send commands; buttons are added only after learning.

add_command.title: Learn a button
add_command.description: Choose a command label from the library or enter a custom one (for example Power, Mute or VOL +). Then point the original remote at the IR hub and press the button.

rename_remote.title: Rename remote
rename_remote.description: Changing the visible name does not change the learned signal namespace or Home Assistant entity IDs.

remove_command.title: Remove button
remove_command.description: Delete the selected button from the virtual remote? Physical-driver IR storage is not deleted.

remove_remote.title: Delete remote {name}
remove_remote.description: This removes its Home Assistant virtual remote and buttons. Physical hub and separately stored driver signals remain untouched.

interface.title: Advanced editor
interface.description: For most users, Home Assistant's Configure wizard is sufficient. The optional legacy editor adds a sidebar item.

data.show_panel: Show advanced IR Studio panel in sidebar

rename_command.title: Rename button
rename_command.description: The visible label changes; the stored IR signal does not.

change_icon.title: Remote icon
change_icon.description: Choose an icon from Home Assistant's visual MDI picker. Signals remain unchanged.

test_button.title: Test button
test_button.description: On confirmation, send the IR command ONCE. A successful call does not prove the appliance received it.

relearn_button.title: Relearn button
relearn_button.description: Learn a replacement signal. The button name, HA unique ID and IR command namespace remain unchanged.

progress.learn: Waiting for the original remote's IR signal

abort.not_ready: IR Studio is not ready. Check the integration status.
abort.no_profiles: No remote has been created yet.

error.learn_failed: Learning failed. Check Home Assistant logs and try again.
error.busy: An IR learning job is still running.
error.send_failed: IR transmission failed. Check gateway and logs.
